description: A Dataset on Public Bus Transportation during Normal and Grand Prix Seasons in the Macao Area is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Song-Kyoo Kim et al. The study investigates public bus transportation data in Macau during normal and Macau Grand Prix seasons. Utilizing real-time data collected from the Transport database, a comparative analysis highlights variations in bus operational metrics such as passenger flow, arrival times, and traffic conditions between standard and event periods. Coverage: not stated; published in 2025. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 4234737 Bytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
